kind: bench
depth: focused
-- base/examples/complete/main.tf --
module "this" {
  source = "../.."
  name   = "example"
  vpc_id = "vpc-1"
}

output "cluster_arn" {
  value = module.this.cluster_arn
}
-- base/main.tf --
resource "aws_security_group" "this" {
  count  = var.create_security_group ? 1 : 0
  name   = var.name
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
}

resource "aws_rds_cluster" "this" {
  cluster_identifier     = var.name
  engine                 = "aurora-postgresql"
  vpc_security_group_ids = compact(concat(aws_security_group.this[*].id, var.vpc_security_group_ids))
}
-- base/outputs.tf --
output "cluster_arn" {
  value = aws_rds_cluster.this.arn
}
-- base/variables.tf --
variable "name" {
  type = string
}

variable "create_security_group" {
  type    = bool
  default = true
}

variable "vpc_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "vpc_security_group_ids" {
  type    = list(string)
  default = []
}
-- base/versions.tf --
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.7"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = ">= 5.0"
    }
  }
}
